citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
Two protocols do not provide written assurance that the activities do not unnecessarily duplicate previous experiments,
that animals' living conditions will be appropriate for their species and that medical care for animals will be available and
provided as necessary by a qualified veterinarian. No animals are currently assigned to either protocol but both protocols
are approved by the IACUC. An animal use proposal must include complete information related to the care and use of the
animals to allow the IACUC to determine the proposed activities are in accordance with the requirements of the Animal
Welfare Act. Correct no later than November 16, 2026 by ensuring protocols contain all required information.

citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
Two protocols do not contain a rationale for involving animals, and for the appropriateness of the species and numbers of
animals to be used or a description of any euthanasia method to be used. In addition, the equine teaching protocol does
not contain an approximate number of animals to be used. No animals are currently assigned to either protocol but both
protocols are approved by the IACUC. An animal use proposal must include complete information related to the care and
use of the animals to allow the IACUC to determine the proposed activities are in accordance with the requirements of the
Animal Welfare Act. Correct no later than November 16, 2026 by ensuring protocols contain all required information.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with an IACUC representative.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
